properties.name: Living cartography
properties.description: A map she draws of a place becomes a folded route: anyone holding it can travel between two marked points in a fraction of the walking distance. A route begins and ends at its marked points, which have no frame of their own unless a point is marked inside an existing doorway or arch. Works only during civil twilight, when solar elevation is between −6° and 0°, inclusive.

properties.name: Ground-bound routes
properties.description: A folded route follows existing walkable ground. It cannot cross water, open air, or any gap without a surface.

properties.name: Closing light
properties.description: When twilight ends, every open route closes; travelers mid-route are set down at the nearer end.

properties.name: Star bearing
properties.description: Under an open sky, she always knows the direction and distance to any place she has mapped. Works only when cloud cover is 30% or less.

properties.name: Walked ground only
properties.description: She can map only places she has crossed on foot herself.

properties.name: Twilight kinship
properties.description: Animals active at dusk treat her as one of their own and neither flee nor attack her. Holds only during civil twilight, when solar elevation is between −6° and 0°, inclusive.

visual_traits.descriptor: small and wiry, a long-distance walker's frame
sun-browned, narrow eyes always half on the horizon
dark hair bound back with a strip of map paper
long dusk-blue travel coat with many flat pockets
dusk violet, ember orange, ink black
a rolled map case worn across the back
lines of ink that glow faintly at dusk

exclusion_candidates.reason: Acts only on how animals treat her; it does not act on routes or bearings
A navigation sense that the profile does not make any route depend on
